title: com.ottoyard.directive.recall (OTTO-Q to operator) -- PROPOSED for contract 0.2, not part of 0.1
description: OTTO-Q asks the operator to bring a car home: by when, for what, and when it expects the car ready again (the Recall Decision, CLAUDE.md 2.7). A request the operator may refuse, like every directive; when it turns the car home it sends a depot.arrival.intent with its own ETA. OTTO-Q never commands the car.

recall_by.description: The latest time OTTO-Q asks the car to be turned home. Earlier is fine; later is a refusal with a reason.

reason.description: Why now. Closed, so the operator's dispatcher can rank recalls against its own work.

services.description: What the visit is for, from the depot's published operation catalog. The charge is always to the owner's own target (rule 8); no service listed here is optional once the car is in (rule 9).

target_ready_time.description: When OTTO-Q expects the car ready for work again if it arrives by recall_by, as a band.
